config_name: Triton healthcare private company screening criteria
notes: Prototype criteria. Every threshold here is a knob: change the number, re-run screening, no code changes.

listing.comment: Hard gate. A listed company is excluded regardless of ownership concentration.

ownership.comment: Family-/founder-owned. PE minority stake acceptable, PE majority excluded.

financial.comment: Minimum EBITDA in EUR millions. The borderline band catches companies close enough to the line that a human should look.

geography.comment: DACH and Nordics primary, UK/Benelux secondary. Anything else is out of scope.

classification.comment: Structural fit alone never reaches active pipeline. It parks on the watchlist until a behavioural trigger is confirmed, and promotion needs a human.

triggers.comment: Four behavioural signal categories. A signal must clear min_confidence_to_confirm AND be corroborated to count as confirmed.

promotion_policy.comment: Not every confirmed trigger is worth a promotion. A founder opening a succession process is the moment of opportunity; a new CFO is interesting but common. Standalone categories justify a promotion proposal on their own. Supporting categories need to appear together, at least supporting_signals_required_for_promotion of them, before a proposal is raised.
